appearances.headline: GPT 6 Luna Preview rolls out to Kiro Enterprise
appearances.newly_possible: Kiro Enterprise organizations can now use GPT 6 Luna in Preview across Kiro clients with a 1M context window and a 0.2x credit multiplier.
appearances.why: A 1M context window at a 0.2x credit rate up to 272K tokens changes the economics of large-repo enterprise coding.
appearances.limits: Inference runs only in the US, credit cost doubles to 0.4x above 272K tokens, and no coding benchmarks are given.
